cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Choose the overseas job or our shared shop. Then we'll know what 'we'll build something' meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said that before the offer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. This choice gives the old sentence its ending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making a job sound like a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking whether your promise has room for the shop without you.

mechanism: A coaches its former business pupil to choose whether an old shared-shop promise meant shared work or merely leaving A to build it alone.
confusable: Not simply choosing a current job: each option is made to define what the earlier we-will-build promise actually meant.
comparison: Business promise reinterpreted by career choice versus domestic space request reinterpreted by key possession.
seedUse: D226 overseas job/shared shop/old promise/before offer/goodbye; S05 planning commitments.
